$comment: Provenance for every figure in docs/diagrams/. Checked by tools/check-manifest.py; see README.md §2 for why. `sources` are the files a figure derives its facts from — a deleted one fails, a changed one warns. `evidence` declares which of a figure's content is measured, read from source, or illustrative, because a reader cannot tell those apart by looking. `generates` lists frames exported from a substrate, which inherit provenance rather than carrying their own.

figures.shows: Muster on the Logos stack: three entry points over app backends, modules, network and runtime, with a dark band for the infrastructure the user does not run. Six selectable views.

sources.note: the module set and its declared dependencies
which inputs are pinned and which follow chat_module's own
what the demo composes, and the invariant-by-invariant table behind the demo-build view
the specified build, the three hosts, ADR-008
the mixnet status this diagram refuses to overstate

evidence.note: The module set and every dependency edge, read off metadata.json and flake.nix rather than drawn from memory
LOGOS-MIXNET at status raw, send-only proof of concept, absent from the near-term roadmap — dated 2026-08 and shown as not shipped. muster-module.lgx is dashed for the same reason: P0 has not run
The neighbouring platform pieces (Files, Swaps, Dex, Storage) place Muster in context; they are not an enumeration of the platform's modules

figures.recheck: Every phase. P0 landing makes muster-module real and it stops being dashed; ADR-010's resolution may remove the chat_module box entirely; any movement on LOGOS-MIXNET changes the network layer.

figures.shows: Shielded-transfer proving time against human-interaction thresholds.

evidence.note: The bars — 6m41s, 7.4min and 447s, on a 13-core desktop against the LEZ testnet, 2026-08-11/12. Whether that is typical is NOT established
The band marked 'a person will wait this long' is a rule of thumb about attention, not something measured here
